time_policy: Normalize source time to zero and preserve native source resolution.
tail_policy: Hold final observed SOC for missing tail when source coverage is shorter than the target year.
boundary_policy: If annual first-last SOC differs by more than 0.01, replace the final 24 hours with a linear return to the initial SOC.
research_boundary: Tail extension and boundary correction are synthetic harmonization steps and are explicitly quantified.
